asr_text: Want an 11 labs voice agent, but no code, five dashboard steps. Create a new assistant, enter a name, and pick the blank template. In the agent tab, set the first message and the system prompt. Add a knowledge base like documentation and FAQs, keep it updated. Pick a voice in the voice tab, then press test OI agent. Rambling answers, the quick start prompt limits responses to a couple of sentences. Save this and watch the full lesson in episode 14.
